settings.home_content: {"heroTitle":"1Healthcare staffing CRM & nurse scheduling software for US and Canadian agencies","heroSubtitle":"20X streamlines compliance, scheduling, e-timesheets, and invoicing—so teams fill shifts faster and stay audit-ready.","heroCtaLabel":"Explore 20X","heroCtaHref":"/nurse-scheduling-software","heroImageUrl":"https://byteriver.tech/website_assets/images/20x-banner1.png","features":[{"title":"Scheduling & Rostering","description":"Assign shifts, broadcast to candidates, reduce time-to-fill.","anchor":"#scheduling","image":""},{"title":"Compliance Tracking","description":"Track licenses, work eligibility, training, vaccinations, expirations; real-time alerts.","anchor":"#compliance"},{"title":"E-Timesheets & Approvals","description":"Digital submissions, approvals, audit history.","anchor":"#timesheets"},{"title":"Payroll & Invoicing Exports","description":"Clean exports for North American payroll/accounting workflows.","anchor":"#payroll"}],"outcomes":[{"title":"Fill shifts faster","description":"reduce cancellations and missed SLAs"},{"title":"Lower compliance risk","description":"proactive alerts prevent non-compliant placements"},{"title":"Fewer admin hours","description":"digital timesheets and clean exports"},{"title":"Healthier cash flow","description":"faster invoicing and fewer disputes"}],"faqs":[{"question":"What is 20X?","answer":"20X is nurse scheduling software and a healthcare staffing CRM that helps agencies in the US and Canada schedule faster and stay compliant."},{"question":"Who uses 20X?","answer":"Healthcare staffing agencies, nursing agencies, hospital staffing teams, and long-term care facilities."},{"question":"Does 20X help with compliance?","answer":"Yes. 20X tracks licenses, work eligibility, training, vaccinations, and expirations with real-time alerts."},{"question":"Does it support e-timesheets and approvals?","answer":"Yes. Workers submit digital timesheets and managers approve with a clear audit trail."},{"question":"Can we export to payroll and accounting?","answer":"Yes. 20X provides clean exports for common North American payroll and accounting workflows."},{"question":"How quickly can we get started?","answer":"Most teams go live within days; migration support is available."}],"insights":[{"title":"5 Ways to Reduce Nurse Scheduling Conflicts","excerpt":"Discover proven strategies healthcare staffing agencies use to minimize scheduling errors and improve nurse satisfaction.","date":"December 15, 2024","slug":"reduce-nurse-scheduling-conflicts"},{"title":"Healthcare Compliance in 2025: What Staffing Agencies Need to Know","excerpt":"Stay ahead of regulatory changes affecting healthcare staffing with our comprehensive compliance guide.","date":"December 10, 2024","slug":"healthcare-compliance-2025"},{"title":"ROI Calculator: How Much Can Healthcare Staffing Software Save?","excerpt":"Calculate the potential savings from implementing automated scheduling and compliance tracking systems.","date":"December 5, 2024","slug":"roi-calculator-staffing-software"}],"finalCta":{"title":"Ready to streamline scheduling? Book a live demo.","subtitle":"See how 20X can transform your healthcare staffing operations with automated scheduling, compliance tracking, and seamless billing.","buttonLabel":"Book a Live Demo","buttonHref":"/contact"}}
